primary_ranking_estimand: Equal-weight mean of within-study C-index across studies with >=1 comparable pair; no cross-study pairs.
bootstrap: 5000 draws of 61 studies with replacement; frozen out-of-fold predictions; exclude unscorable studies only from the concordance denominator; row-pooled exact-outcome error metrics.
limitation: Conditional uncertainty for the archived fitting procedure, not full retraining or future-population validation.
